name: Ruin

components.pose: She sits alone on the broken steps of a ruined chapel, her wings hanging heavy, her chin resting on one hand as she looks toward the camera with a tired, knowing calm; full figure visible.
components.effects: A few black feathers lie on the stone around her and drifting shadow, smoke and pale starlight hang faintly in the still air, {{MAGIC}} light almost gone.

notes: QUIET: Ruin, for her alignment (rank 10); from data/art/_settings/scene-recipes.json.
